subject: Acme POC kickoff – scheduling and owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Smith <laura.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC kickoff – scheduling

Hi Laura –

Great to be moving forward on the POC. We'd like to schedule a 60–90 minute kickoff to align on success criteria, timeline, and owners across engineering, security, and procurement. Proposed slots (PT):

- Wed, Jun 9 – 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Thu, Jun 10 – 1:00–2:30 PM PT

Please let me know which works for the Acme team and who else we should include (procurement, security, customer engineers). I've attached a short kickoff agenda and a draft SOW for procurement to review.

Agenda highlights: success criteria, timeline & milestones, network/prep items, roles/owners.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: POC_Kickoff_Agenda_v1.pdf]

From: Laura Smith <laura.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff – scheduling

Hi Marissa –

Thanks – excited to get started. Wed, Jun 9 at 10:00 AM PT is tight for our lead engineer (Rajiv). Can we move to 11:30 AM PT that day? Also copying procurement and Rajiv; procurement will want the SOW and high-level T&Cs before the kickoff.

Security will also want to attend for the first 20 minutes to cover data handling – I'll loop them if we lock a time.

Best,
Laura
Director of AI Products, Acme Corp
laura.smith@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Smith <laura.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff – scheduling

Thanks, Laura – 11:30 AM PT on Wed, Jun 9 works for us.

Dev – can you confirm availability for 11:30–1:00 PM PT on Jun 9? Also note Neha (security) is cc'd – Neha, would you be able to join the first 20 minutes to cover data access, retention, and audit log expectations?

Procurement – I attached the draft SOW in the original note; happy to send a redline before the meeting if useful.

If everyone confirms, I'll send a calendar invite with the agenda + calendar link.

Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Smith <laura.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff – scheduling

I'm available Wed, Jun 9 11:30–1:00 PM PT. I'll prepare the environment checklist (network/IPs, firewall rules, credentials, example prompts) and a short demo of the sample workload so we can validate success criteria in-session.

Rajiv – can you confirm whether you'll need VPN access or if test endpoints will be exposed publicly? That changes prep steps.

Thanks – Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
[Attachment: env-checklist-template.txt]

From: Laura Smith <laura.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff – scheduling

Quick update – our security lead had a conflict and asked to shift the kickoff to Thu, Jun 10 at 1:00 PM PT so they can attend. Procurement also asked for the draft SOW + high-level milestones up front.

Proposed confirmed: Thu, Jun 10 – 1:00–2:30 PM PT (please confirm).

Also, for the kickoff we'd like to confirm success criteria so procurement has measurable milestones:
- Integration: vendor can ingest/save 10k sample records without errors
- Latency: average generation latency < 300ms for 512-token prompts
- Security: KV caching disabled for customer data; audit logs available daily

Owners from our side: Laura (Product), Rajiv (Eng), Procurement. Please add Redwood owners and timeline for milestones.

Thanks,
Laura

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Smith <laura.smith@acme.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff – scheduling (CONFIRMED)

Thanks – Thu, Jun 10 at 1:00–2:30 PM PT is confirmed. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-poc-kickoff-20260610 (attached .ics).

Attached: POC_SOW_Draft.pdf (for procurement) and the kickoff agenda. Below are the kickoff success criteria / owners / 2-week timeline we'll use to steer the POC:

Success criteria (agreed):
- Integration: Redwood ingestion connector accepts 10k sample records with <0.1% error rate (Owner: Rajiv / Redwood SE)
- Latency: average generation latency < 300ms @ 512 tokens for 95th percentile (Owner: Dev Patel / Redwood infra)
- Security & Data Handling: KV cache disabled for customer-specific keys; daily audit log delivery to Acme S3 (Owner: Neha Kapoor / Redwood security)
- Business outcome: Demo of prioritized user flow with >80% accuracy on rubric (Owner: Laura / Product)

Timeline (high level):
- Day 0 (kickoff): confirm access, finalize SOW milestones, assign tasks
- Day 3: connectivity & test data ingestion validation
- Day 7: performance tuning & latency check with 512-token workload
- Day 14: final demo + go/no-go review with procurement

Owners & Next steps:
- Marissa (AE): program manager / single point of contact for scheduling and commercial questions
- Dev Patel (SE): technical lead for integration & demo
- Neha Kapoor (Security): security lead for data handling and audit logs
- Rajiv Patel (Acme Eng): customer technical owner for ingestion & test dataset
- Procurement (Acme): finalize SOW and PO by Day 14

Please review and reply if any items need adjusting. Looking forward to Thursday.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: POC_SOW_Draft.pdf, calendar-invite.ics]
